title: Detecting Bias in Large Language Models: Fine-tuned KcBERT

bias_targets.methodology: Using a template-based Masked Language Modeling (MLM) approach and the Categorical Bias Score (CBS) metric to measure variance in target prediction probabilities across 31 countries and 55 social positions.

Using a template-based Masked Language Modeling (MLM) approach and the Log-Probability Bias Score (LPBS) metric to compare target prediction probabilities between two genders across 55 social positions.
